description: This Kotlin source file is for an Android application's main activity implementing a CGPA calculator. It manages input fields, a RecyclerView for subjects, calculates CGPA based on grades and credits, and maintains a history of calculations.

classes.name: SubjectEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a subject with its name, grade point, and credit string.

classes.name: GradePoint
classes.description: Enum class mapping grades to their labels and point values.

classes.name: SubjectAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying and editing subject entries, supporting delete and change listeners.

classes.name: HistoryItem
classes.description: Data class capturing a historical snapshot of CGPA calculation, including timestamp, subject entries, CGPA, and total credits.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets up spinners, recycler view, interactions, and updates the CGPA summary.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Binds UI view references to class variables.

methods.name: setupGradeSpinner
methods.description: Sets up the dropdown spinner with grade options.

methods.name: setupRecycler
methods.description: Configures the recycler view with the subject adapter.

methods.name: setupInteractions
methods.description: Defines button click and input field behaviors, including adding entries and saving history.

methods.name: tryAddEntry
methods.description: Validates input fields and adds a new subject entry if valid.

methods.name: updateSummary
methods.description: Calculates and displays current CGPA and total credits.

methods.name: calculateCGPA
methods.description: Computes CGPA via weighted average based on subject grades and credits.

methods.name: renderHistory
methods.description: Displays saved history of previous calculations.
